question: International Solar Alliance (ISA) aims to mobilize _______ trillion dollar in solar investments by 2030.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 trillion dollar**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **International Solar Alliance (ISA)** is a global initiative launched on **30 November 2015**, during the COP21 climate conference in Paris by **India and France**. 
• The main aim of ISA is to promote the use of **solar energy** and scale up solar investments globally to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and combat climate change. 
• ISA has set a target to mobilize **1 trillion dollars** in solar investments by **2030** to support the development of solar energy infrastructure, technology innovation, and capacity building. 
• The alliance focuses on countries that lie between the tropics of Cancer and Capricorn, as these regions receive abundant sunlight throughout the year, enabling large-scale solar energy generation. 
• ISA works to promote cooperation among its member countries, share knowledge and technology, and pool financial resources to achieve its ambitious goals. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **International Solar Alliance (ISA):** 
• It aims to bring together countries to work collaboratively on **solar technologies**, **solar financing**, and **capacity building**. 
• ISA has **112 member countries** as of 2023, primarily from regions with high solar potential. 
• It facilitates the development of solar projects by offering technical assistance, capacity building, and financial support. 
• India hosts the headquarters of ISA, located in **Gurugram, Haryana**. This highlights India's leadership role in promoting solar energy. 
• ISA initiatives include programs like **Affordable Finance at Scale** and **Scaling Solar Applications for Agriculture Use** to maximize solar energy deployment. 
• **Solar Energy Benefits:** 
• Solar energy is a **renewable energy source** and contributes to reducing **carbon emissions**. 
• It is an effective tool for combating **climate change** and achieving **sustainable development** goals. 
• Solar energy helps in reducing dependency on **fossil fuels**, leading to energy security. 
• It is cost-effective in the long term, provides **clean power**, and creates **employment opportunities** in the renewable energy sector. 
• **Global Solar Energy Scenario:** 
• Countries like **India, China, USA, Germany**, and **Australia** are leading in solar energy adoption. 
• The global solar energy market is expected to grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of **20%** from 2023 to 2030. 
• Major solar energy projects include India's **Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park**, China's **Tengger Desert Solar Park**, and the US's **Ivanpah Solar Power Facility**. 
• Innovative technologies like **solar panels**, **solar thermal systems**, and **solar batteries** are driving the adoption of solar energy worldwide. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Paris Agreement:** ISA aligns with the objectives of the **Paris Agreement**, which aims to limit global warming to below **2°C** above pre-industrial levels. 
• **Solar Energy Potential:** Studies indicate that solar energy has the potential to meet **global energy demand** several times over, making it a crucial resource for sustainable energy transitions. 
• **India’s Solar Energy Goals:** India has set a target of achieving **500 GW of renewable energy capacity** by **2030**, including **280 GW** from solar energy. 
• **Solar Finance:** Mobilizing **1 trillion dollars** in investment is critical for overcoming barriers like high initial costs, technology gaps, and lack of infrastructure in developing countries. 
• **ISA Programs:** Key ISA programs include **Solar Parks**, **Solar Mini Grids**, and **Solar Rooftop Initiatives** to promote solar adoption across sectors.
